services.name: Charter Info
services.desc: Join a shared Chesapeake Bay fishing charter by the seat - per-person walk-on trips from Queen Anne Marina in Stevensville, MD, an easy drive from Kent Island, Annapolis, Baltimore & Washington, DC. Your card's balance is applied at checkout; you'll only pay any remaining amount. Walk-on charters let individual anglers and small groups join a shared fishing trip from Queen Anne Marina in Stevensville, Maryland, without chartering the whole boat. Seats are sold per person at the price posted on each departure, and every trip runs with a licensed captain and mate. Rods, reels, bait, tackle, and the required Maryland fishing license are included - bring food, drinks, weather-appropriate
